narrative.recommendations_md: 12 recommendations across 4 strategic themes, with 2 CRITICAL + 7 HIGH + 3 MEDIUM priorities. Each recommendation follows ROOT CAUSE → SOLUTION → EXPECTED OUTCOMES structure with evidence triangulation across internal (IB-1..IB-9), external (247 public sources), and proxy (PROXY-001..004) evidence. Stress-test via web_search + Dice substitute (Explorium/Tavily credits exhausted) confirmed 5 tech products ABSENT (Shield, Privacy Center, Data Cloud, Tableau, Agentforce) as valid Zennify targets; 2 products PRESENT (MuleSoft, Marketing Cloud) reframed as expansion/consolidation opportunities.
narrative.roadmap_md: The 12-recommendation roadmap sequences through four waves, each anchored to institutional milestones rather than fixed timelines per communication standards.
